subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should done-only JSON promotion with transient visible JSON become shared provider behavior, or must JSON candidates be buffered or otherwise reconciled before they can be promoted?
rationale: The branch intentionally accepts simultaneous visible JSON delivery and later tool execution, while current main already supports native Ollama tool calls; choosing that permanent compatibility and user-experience boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Require stream-safe promotion
options.body: Buffer or reconcile complete JSON candidates so content cannot be delivered as ordinary text before becoming a tool call, while preserving ordinary JSON prose.

options.title: Accept transient JSON
options.body: Approve done-only promotion as an explicit compatibility tradeoff after the parser defects and live provider proof are resolved.

options.title: Limit work to native Ollama
options.body: Defer the shared fallback until the linked issue's API route and native structured-call path are reproduced and diagnosed.

recommendation.title: Require stream-safe promotion
recommendation.body: Buffer or reconcile complete JSON candidates so content cannot be delivered as ordinary text before becoming a tool call, while preserving ordinary JSON prose.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current shared parser and stream-normalizer architecture where this behavioral boundary is owned.
